note: Every requirement here is something a reviewer, an ethics board or a regulator would refuse to accept, not a task list. A criterion flips to done only by editing `done` to true and filling `evidence` with a path in this repository plus a note saying what that path shows. Deliberately NOT copied from nurse-ratchet: that file grades clinical validity under a clinical schema, and ELIZA is not a clinical instrument. Unlike nurse-ratchet this tree ships no tools/certification_bar.py, so nothing here is machine-checked yet; `tools/eliza_release_gate.py --check` is the only gate that runs, and it is a paperwork-and-allowlist gate that does not grade the science. Treat a PASS from it as the absence of a paperwork objection, never as an endorsement.

requirements.title: A crisis router whose recall can be stated as one number

criteria.text: Holdouts written before the change they grade, each scored once, with the fitted dev split excluded from the figure

evidence.note: Limitations 1: dev 1.00 is marked fitted and excluded; holdout 0.83, holdout2 0.83, holdout3 0.18, each scored once

criteria.text: One recall figure, with a lower bound the authors cannot move after seeing the result
A labelled corpus the author did not write (the current one is invented utterances, not transcripts)

requirements.title: A human in the loop, built rather than asserted

criteria.text: An elevated-risk signal ends the intervention and hands off, rather than continuing to counsel

evidence.note: What this is not: on any elevated risk signal it stops being an intervention engine and becomes a router to people; Limitations 1 makes a human in the loop a hard requirement, not advice

criteria.text: An escalation path into a named human's queue
A duty-of-care contract with on-call coverage
An instrument exists that refuses to fit below its own thresholds

evidence.note: Limitations 2: probes a real memory store and exits 2 because 119 curated memories carry no construct readings; the refusal is the current answer

criteria.text: Fifty sessions from one instrument version, the floor for a per-person bridge
Norms and a factor structure for the items (written for this project, not a validated inventory)

requirements.title: Evidence from someone other than the author

criteria.text: An estimator check on data whose structure is known, so the estimator itself is not the question

evidence.note: Limitations 3: the plant-and-recover test proves the estimator works on data whose structure is known and says nothing about a real person

criteria.text: An evaluation on real people's data under a stated consent basis
The reflexivity problem mitigated: someone who learns their own prototypes and edits toward them is not silently reinforced

requirements.title: The shipped package can be traced to authored source

criteria.text: The generated-versus-authored boundary is written down and checkable

evidence.note: Limitations 5: eliza/psyche/* is materialised from src/PSYCHE, an edit to the generated copy is lost on the next materialise and shows as drift under `publicize.py --check`

criteria.text: A released artefact whose commit is recorded and reproducible from that commit

requirements.title: Case data stays out, and the line is enforced

criteria.text: The line is stated in a policy a reader can hold the project to

evidence.note: Ethics: DISCLOSURE_POLICY.md states the line on named individuals in mental health, tenancy and employment records

criteria.text: An allowlist a machine reads, rather than a promise a person keeps

evidence.note: Ethics: PUBLIC_MANIFEST.json enforces the disclosure line

criteria.text: A build step that fails when something crosses the line

evidence.note: Ethics and Status: the release gate fails the build when something crosses the line; it is a paperwork-and-allowlist gate and cannot grade the science
